identity: Blackwind Rise is the undead's grave country on the Throng's flank: the bone forest walks at night, and bandits sell the dead's linen to anyone who pays.

quests.title: Something for Those Who Wait
quests.text: The carriers and escorts who reach Ashveil Watch often arrive hungry enough to resent a welcome speech. Bring me six Mushrooms for their meal. I can listen while they eat; it usually improves the account of the journey.
quests.lesson: A local task; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Ramps on the Mesa
quests.text: Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post on Bannerbreak Mesa needs help keeping his crews supplied. Go and speak to him. You will hear plenty about the beams, but listen a little longer and you will hear who is carrying them.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Orrel Keeps What Is Left
quests.text: Orrel Hollowstep at Hollowarch Station cares for belongings recovered from the fighting until they can go home. Speak to him about the work waiting there. He grumbles over every frayed edge, and remembers whose coat it belongs to.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Light for the Late Road
quests.text: Late arrivals at Blackwind Mining Camp need a light to find the loading ground. Trim the signal lantern there and let me know when it is ready. Even someone who has outlived their eyesight appreciates knowing that they are expected.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K11 A: the camp's held load (a town place every mining camp has).

quests.title: The Names Stay with the Cloth
quests.text: A bundle of stolen shrouds was left at the {name:recovery_rest}, {dir_from_giver:recovery_rest}, with the owners' labels still attached. Secure it there and bring me word, keeping each name with its cloth. I can arrange the return once I know the bundle is safe. A thief may see a length of linen; I know people who would recognise the stitching.
quests.completion: The labels are still with their shrouds, so I can arrange for each one to go back to the right person. That will spare somebody the indignity of having to describe their own burial clothes again.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K8 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Deadmarch (the 38-40 moor; it falls back to the belt's woods where the moor forms no region, seed 42, so the text names the place, not the kind).

quests.title: Party: The Bell in the Wood
quests.text: {name:hollowbell_treant} is trampling the {name:hollowwood}, ringing loudly enough for us to hear it at the station. Gather a group and fell it, {dir_from_giver:hollowbell_treant}, before it crushes another working party. I know the difference between a solemn bell and a tree announcing that it intends to step on you.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra; the recovery rest lies away from it.

quests.title: Work Waiting at Red Ramp
quests.text: Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post on Bannerbreak Mesa is looking for people to help with his work on the front. Go and hear what he needs. He has strong opinions about roads, and most of them concern getting his crews home along one.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7): Orrel's and Vaska's front lines start at 46 and 53.

quests.title: The Promise Still Stands
quests.text: The guild has compared the report of your camp raid with our lost loads: goods carrying our marks were laid out for the enemy's building work. The Accord took them in an open attack on our transport. Bring the combined report to Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa. The Oathdelvers stand by the delivery to the original crews, and she should have that promise beside the losses.
quests.completion: This old supply order, countersigned by Tallykeeper Mardra, names the ramp crews, guards and guild workers still waiting for their share. The Oathdelvers' renewed promise stands beside those names now, and I will hold our suppliers to it. Speak to the Warmaster at Bannerbreak Warhold; I want someone who remembers who is waiting when the fighting is over.

variants.text: The guild has compared the report of your camp raid with our lost loads: goods carrying our marks were laid out for the enemy's building work. The Accord took them in an open attack on our transport. Bring the combined report to Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa. The Oathdelvers stand by the delivery to the original crews, and she should have that promise beside the losses.

I have checked the report of your camp raid: goods taken from our transport in an open attack were stacked for The Accord's building work. Their marks match the supplies promised to the ramp crews, guards and guild workers. Take my renewed delivery promise with that report to Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold. Those crews did their share, and The Oathdelvers will answer for ours.

The guild's report of your camp raid names our cargo among the stores set aside for the enemy's construction. The Accord carried it off in an open attack on our transport, leaving our crews waiting for what they were promised. Take the combined report and The Oathdelvers' renewed delivery promise to Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa. The next carriers need to leave with a load they can deliver, and Yarra knows who is waiting for it.

quests.lesson: Chapter 3 of the story arc (story, may chain): a travel from any band foreman of the faction.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. T5 (story, 40, K1 A): requires T4 and the free camp raid (its one Throng follow-up); any of the three Throng band foremen gives it (a raid elsewhere counts).

quests.title: Name Every Hand
quests.text: Both orders are settled; this border report names the drivers and workers affected by lost cargo, with no one buried under a total. Bring the border report to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr for The Oathdelvers.
quests.completion: The drivers and workers are named clearly beside the lost cargo. The Oathdelvers collect these border reports to keep track of whom a loss has left in need. I will enter every name as written.

variants.text: Both orders are settled; this border report names the drivers and workers affected by lost cargo, with no one buried under a total. Bring the border report to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr for The Oathdelvers.
variants.completion: The drivers and workers are named clearly beside the lost cargo. The Oathdelvers collect these border reports to keep track of whom a loss has left in need. I will enter every name as written.

variants.text: The silver and sapphire are accounted for; I have written the drivers and workers affected by our lost loads into this border report. Bring the border report to Drava Flintshoulder at the Miner's Guild house in Gor Drazhak for The Oathdelvers.
variants.completion: Here are the missing loads, and here are the drivers and workers who bore the loss. The Oathdelvers need both in a border report before we can say what help is owed. Your foreman has given us something we can act on.

variants.text: Both orders are filled, and this border report is ready; it names the drivers and workers who bore the trouble when the cargo was lost. Bring the border report to Ombali Ropekeeper at the Miner's Guild house in Kezamba for The Oathdelvers.
variants.completion: The lost cargo has a tally, and the drivers and workers have names of their own. The Oathdelvers gather news from the border so we can ask those people what is still needed. This report gives us someone to ask.

quests.notes: Round 58 follow-up of tier 4 (The Oathdelvers): story seed: A short camp report names the affected drivers and workers beside the lost cargo and shows why the guild collects news from the border.

quests.title: Get the Late Shift Home
quests.text: Pall Weavers string webs across our workers' way through the bone forest at night. Kill three Pall Weavers at night in the {name:bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:bonewood}. My crew has spent enough shifts pulling each other loose.

variants.text: Pall Weavers string webs across our workers' way through the bone forest at night. Kill three Pall Weavers at night in the {name:bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:bonewood}. My crew has spent enough shifts pulling each other loose.

Shade Panthers follow our porters through the jungle at night, waiting for one to fall behind. Hunt three Shade Panthers at night in the {name:canopy}, which lies {zone_area:canopy}. We promised every carrier a place by the camp fire, and I intend to keep every place filled.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L31-33) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met only at night (a third of the day count).
